about.title:
BANNED AT HOME.
STAGED IN VENICE.
about.body: Belarus Free Theatre is the only theatre in Europe banned by its own government on political grounds. From exile, they bring Official. Unofficial. Belarus. to La Biennale di Venezia — a work made under surveillance, about surveillance.

feeds.artwork: Photograph from the Official. Unofficial. Belarus. exhibition by Belarus Free Theatre at La Biennale di Venezia

visit.title: FIND THE DOOR.
visit.body: Open during La Biennale di Venezia. Full visiting information — opening hours, tickets, the official venue map — is published by the Biennale.
